prefill_pool.arithmetic: 17152 - 16384 = 768 = 12 * 64 tokens. Old 32768 request exceeded capacity by 15616 tokens; 16384 is half the old requested pool. Target FP8 KV uses 94 layers * 2 (K,V) * 4 local KV heads * 128 bytes = 96256 bytes/token; lowering from 17152 to 16384 saves 0.06884765625 GiB target KV per rank. Additional target KV for 32768 would be 1.39990234375 GiB, excluding draft/runtime allocations. Parent prior total memory-budget estimate for preserving 32768 was about 0.931 (increase 0.031); retain measured-safe 0.90 instead.
prefill_pool.capacity_guard: Unchanged actual-capacity equality check; future run must still pass on all eight Prefill DP ranks.

decode_selection.reason: FA3 runtime guard excludes even the conservative ASPIRE B22 upper bound. Dense guard can accept M<=88, but its performance selection times M176; smaller boundary rows are numeric checks only. Neither selection measures serving performance at ASPIRE shapes. Keep stock Decode selections; other automatic overlay fusions remain enabled, and unchanged full numeric gate still runs.

result.interpretation: Prefill-capacity bound: 8 Prefill DP ranks each take about one 3986-token request per 4096-token iteration, so capacity is 8 / 0.2668 s = 30.0 req/s against 29.9 req/s served. The 2.6% shorter Prefill iteration explains the gain; Decode ITL also fell 5% but Decode does not bind. Single run against a single baseline run with a different Prefill pool (17152 actual vs 16384); not a repeatability claim.
